name: WHY ARE YOU A MONSTER?
source:
As she drifts through her monotonous routines, Ingrid briefly reconnects with her childhood friend. There's only one problem...

A visual novel where you play as a very repressed homosexual in an unspecified year in the 1900s.

[From [url=https://nepcoolestnuisance.itch.io/why-are-you-a-monster]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当英格丽德度过单调的日常生活时，她短暂地与她儿时的朋友重新建立了联系。只有一个问题…

这是一部视觉小说，你在1900年代的某个年份扮演一位非常压抑的同性恋者。

[来自[url=https://nepcoolestnuisance.itch.io/why-are-you-a-monster]itch.io[/url]]
